pages.text: $(bold)Some addresses are not people.$(br2)$(li)The $(thing)Mail Service$(n) trades by post: a diamond buys a parcel of lost mail.$(br)$(li)The $(thing)Automated Supply Service$(n) crafts what you send it the ingredients for.$(br2)Anything it sends back still obeys the ring: a locked item stays locked.
